chapterInfo.content:
15
Abɔfoɔ a wɔkurakura ɔhaw mmusuo a ɛtwa toɔ no
1 # Adi 12.1; 12.3; 11.18 Na mehunuu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ foforɔ bi a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwanwa ɔsoro: Abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura ɔhaw mmusuo nson a ɛtwa toɔ a ɛno na ɛtwa Onyankopɔn abufuo no to.
2 # Adi 4.6; 13.15; 13.18; 5.8 Na mehunuu biribi a ɛte sɛ ahwehwɛ po a egya fra mu. Na wɔn a wɔdii aboa no, ne ne honi, ne ne din akontahyɛdeɛ ho nkonim no gyinagyina ahwehwɛ po no ano kurakura Nyankopɔn nsankuo. 3#Eks 15.1; 15.11; Adi 5.9; 5.12; Dwom 145.17; Yer 10.6-7 Na wɔto Nyankopɔn akoa Mose dwom ne Adwammaa no dwom sɛ:
Awurade Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so tumfoɔ,
wo nnwuma yɛ akɛseɛ na ɛyɛ nwanwa.
Amanaman hene, w’akwan tene na ɛyɛ nokorɛ.
4 # Dwom 86.9 Awurade, hwan na ɔrensuro woɔ
na ɔrenhyɛ wo din animuonyam?
Ɛfiri sɛ wo nko na woyɛ kronkron,
na amanaman nyinaa bɛba
abɛkoto w’anim,
ɛfiri sɛ w’atɛn tenenee ada adi.
5 # Adi 11.19 Na yeinom akyiri no mehwɛe, na wɔahini adanseɛ ntomadan asɔredan no ɔsoro. 6#Adi 1.13 Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura ɔhaw mmusuo nson no firi asɔredan no mu firii adi, wɔhyehyɛ nwera fitafitaa a ɛhran, na wɔde sika abɔsoɔ abobɔ wɔn mu. 7#Adi 4.6-8; 14.10 Na ateasefoɔ baanan no mu baako maa abɔfoɔ baason no sika nkuruwa nson a wɔde Nyankopɔn a ɔte ase daa daa no abufuo no ahyɛ mu mama. 8#Eks 40.34; 1 Ah 8.10; Yes 6.4; Hes 44.4 Na wisie a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn animuonyam ne ne tumi no mu hyɛɛ asɔredan no ma, na obiara antumi ankɔ asɔredan no mu kɔsii sɛ wɔwiee abɔfoɔ baason no ɔhaw mmusuo nson no ansa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na mehunuu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ foforɔ bi a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwanwa ɔsoro: Abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura ɔhaw mmusuo nson a ɛtwa toɔ a ɛno na ɛtwa Onyankopɔn abufuo no to.
Na mehunuu biribi a ɛte sɛ ahwehwɛ po a egya fra mu. Na wɔn a wɔdii aboa no, ne ne honi, ne ne din akontahyɛdeɛ ho nkonim no gyinagyina ahwehwɛ po no ano kurakura Nyankopɔn nsankuo. Na wɔto Nyankopɔn akoa Mose dwom ne Adwammaa no dwom sɛ:
Awurade Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so tumfoɔ,
wo nnwuma yɛ akɛseɛ na ɛyɛ nwanwa.
Amanaman hene, w’akwan tene na ɛyɛ nokorɛ.
Awurade, hwan na ɔrensuro woɔ
na ɔrenhyɛ wo din animuonyam?
Ɛfiri sɛ wo nko na woyɛ kronkron,
na amanaman nyinaa bɛba
abɛkoto w’anim,
ɛfiri sɛ w’atɛn tenenee ada adi.

Na yeinom akyiri no mehwɛe, na wɔahini adanseɛ ntomadan asɔredan no ɔsoro. Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura ɔhaw mmusuo nson no firi asɔredan no mu firii adi, wɔhyehyɛ nwera fitafitaa a ɛhran, na wɔde sika abɔsoɔ abobɔ wɔn mu. Na ateasefoɔ baanan no mu baako maa abɔfoɔ baason no sika nkuruwa nson a wɔde Nyankopɔn a ɔte ase daa daa no abufuo no ahyɛ mu mama. Na wisie a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn animuonyam ne ne tumi no mu hyɛɛ asɔredan no ma, na obiara antumi ankɔ asɔredan no mu kɔsii sɛ wɔwiee abɔfoɔ baason no ɔhaw mmusuo nson no ansa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
